page.overview:
Who is Arl'Tokor?

Arl'Tokor was a Cathar merchant who lived on the planet Taris during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. A brown-spotted Cathar male with brownish-orange fur, a brown mane, and orange eyes, they were one of many of their species who settled on Taris. A fluent speaker of Basic, Arl'Tokor wore heavy armor for protection from the world's wildlife. They sold weapon and armor modifications from their shop in Olaris, the headquarters of the Republic-sponsored Taris Resettlement Initiative.

Arl'Tokor appeared in the massively multiplayer online role-playing video game Star Wars: The Old Republic, released by BioWare in 2011, as a Mods Vendor for Republic players on Taris. they were removed from the game along with the rest of the Mods Vendors.
